title: Relax isolated PCBM molecule
action: Construct the PCBM molecule (C72H14O2) and relax it in a large supercell using DFT-LDA with only the Γ-point. Record the total energy and geometry.
description: Produces the reference molecular geometry and total energy needed for crystal binding energies.

title: Relax cubic crystal structures
action: For sc, bcc, fcc, construct primitive cells with one relaxed PCBM molecule and perform variable-cell DFT relaxations using LDA. Compute the binding energy per molecule.
description: Contains optimized lattice parameters, cell volumes, total energies, and binding energies for each phase.

title: Compute band structures
action: For each relaxed crystal, run SCF with a denser k-mesh then non-SCF along high-symmetry paths to obtain band eigenvalues. Identify VBM and CBM energies and k-point locations.
description: Band eigenvalues, VBM and CBM positions, and gap information for each crystal.

title: Compile electronic properties
action: Extract Eg, gap_type, VBM_kpoint, CBM_kpoint, Eb for each cubic phase and write to electronic_properties.json.
description: Final scored artifact with band gaps, gap types, k-point labels, and binding energies for sc, bcc, fcc PCBM crystals.
